answer: The system gives weight only to identities that finish a sequential 72-hour delay proof, so each fake waits its own 72 hours before earning. At enrollment a timber plug is driven into its locked box; it absorbs moisture and must measure 2 millimeters wider at hour 72. Inside, 10 milliliters of nectar sit in an open vial; below 8 milliliters at opening confirms the box stayed sealed. At opening a falcon carries the key to the auditor, valid only if logged after hour 72. 100 fakes need 100 boxes and 7,200 identity-hours; elapsed time cannot transfer.
